newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds closed little changed to easier. Bonds with long maturities posted only narrow losses after coming under pressure yesterday, but the weaker Swiss franc and lower Eurofranc futures weighed on government bonds.
Dealers said activity was thinned by summer holidays and uncertainty over the market's future direction.
Cargill's 150 million franc, five-year bond, the U.S. company's first Swiss issue, met good retail demand in the grey market. It yielded 2.67 percent on the offer side.
The eight-year Pfandbriefbank bond was yielding 3.28 percent in the grey market amid a scarcity of supply.
